findings.claim: 經查未見 Autoliv 銷售通路／商業模式（訂閱化、D2C、平台化）結構性轉變的一手紀錄；客戶結構上，2026 Q2 對中國本土 OEM 銷售有機成長約 44%，對全球 OEM 下滑約 24%，中國 OEM 占中國銷售 55%（去年同期約 40%）。
findings.excerpt: Autoliv's sales to domestic OEMs increased organically by around 44% while our sales to global OEMs decreased by around 24%.

findings.claim: 2026-07-08 Autoliv 與小鵬簽策略合作框架，CTO 稱關係由傳統供應轉向共同創新與共同開發。
findings.source: Gasgoo：Autoliv, XPENG Group Sign Strategic Cooperation Agreement
findings.excerpt: the collaboration is evolving from a conventional supply relationship into a model focused on joint innovation and co-development.

findings.claim: 2025 年亞洲 OEM 占合併淨銷售約 48%，中國 OEM 約 8%，歐洲品牌 30%，美系 20%；銷售仍為直接對 OEM。
findings.excerpt: As a group Asian OEMs represented around 48% of the Company's consolidated net sales in 2025, of which Japanese OEMs accounted for almost two thirds.

note: 通路面查無結構性轉變來源；僅客戶組合與合作模式有變。部落格稱轉向整合安全套件，低權威未採用。
